posts.hook: OpenAI ships a real agents platform, then asks congress if slowing down AI would be illegal
posts.caption: openai shipped a managed agents api and sam altman told staff the company may deliberately slow down, oracle's cloud revenue jumped 121% this quarter, and california signed new limits on minors' social media and chatbot use. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: OpenAI opened a full Agents API for cloud agents
slides.desc: One call spins up long-running, tool-using agents on the Codex harness

slides.title: Altman told staff OpenAI may deliberately slow down
slides.desc: He hopes rivals follow, and asked Congress if coordinating that is even legal

slides.title: Oracle's cloud revenue jumped 121% this quarter
slides.desc: $19.35B total revenue beat estimates, shares jumped ==6%+== after hours

slides.title: California just restricted minors' social media and chatbot use
slides.desc: EFF says the law cuts teens off from support communities instead of fixing platforms

slides.title: Cursor agents can now direct thousands of subagents
slides.desc: A persistent coordinator delegates work and syncs context across your codebase

slides.title: A judge found TikTok liable for child-safety lies
slides.desc: Case heads to trial to set penalties, the same day California passed new limits
